identity.name: DevOps
identity.description: Infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and cloud/on-prem operations across all Posibolt products.

goals: Maintain reliable infrastructure and deployment pipelines for all Posibolt products
Improve CI/CD automation to reduce manual deployment effort and errors
Manage infrastructure cost efficiency across cloud and on-prem environments
Support POS X infrastructure requirements as beta approaches

milestones.name: CI/CD automation covering all active products

kpis.name: Mean time to recover from outage

risks.description: POS X infrastructure requirements not scoped early enough — scramble at launch
risks.mitigation: Infra requirements doc aligned with PXB1 milestones; staging environment mirroring production

risks.description: Manual deployment steps cause errors or outages
risks.mitigation: Automate incrementally; track remaining manual steps as a KPI trending to zero

dependencies.description: POS X infra requirements drive new pipeline and hosting needs

notes: Covers infrastructure and deployment across all products — V8 on-prem and cloud, POS X, Positrack (Railway), analytics (AWS). The instance guide lists this as 'DVPS' but the actual YouTrack code is 'DVP'. CI/CD automation is a work in progress — manual deployment steps still exist and are a source of errors.
